info.description: REST API for Auto Anime Downloader daemon
info.title: Auto Anime Downloader API

get.description: Returns a list of animes with aggregated episode information
Returns anime info from AniList combined with downloaded episodes data
get.summary: Get detail and episodes for a specific anime

delete.description: Deletes a downloaded episode (library hardlink + torrent) and blocks it from being re-downloaded automatically

post.description: Triggers an immediate download for an aired episode and marks it as manually managed
Deletes the existing torrent (if any) and searches Nyaa again for a fresh download
Unblocks and unmanages an episode so the daemon can handle it automatically again
post.summary: Release an episode from manual management

post.description: Deletes the existing torrent (if any) and downloads the episode using the provided magnet link
post.summary: Replace a downloaded episode with a user-supplied magnet link

post.description: Deletes all existing torrents for the anime and downloads using the provided magnet link, marking all aired episodes as downloaded
post.summary: Replace all downloaded episodes of an anime with a user-supplied batch magnet link

get.description: GET returns current settings; PUT updates them

put.description: GET returns current settings; PUT updates them

post.description: Triggers a manual anime verification check

put.description: Updates the daemon configuration with the provided values

get.description: Returns the built-in default priority lists (for the "reset to default" button)

post.description: Starts the daemon loop for automatic anime checking

get.description: Returns the last N lines from the daemon log file

parameters.description: Number of lines to return (default: 1000, max: 10000)
parameters.name: lines

post.description: Fires a named webhook with sample variables to verify connectivity

get.description: Returns the current status of the daemon, including last check time, error state, and disk space for the configured save path

Returns a live snapshot of every torrent in the embedded client — progress, speed, ETA, peers and status — joined with the anime/episode it belongs to. Batch torrents appear once, with a null episode_number. Responds with an empty list (not an error) when no session exists yet, i.e. before completed_anime_path is configured.

post.description: Re-announces the torrent to all trackers and DHT — the way out of "stuck at 0 peers". It does not override the trackers' minimum interval, so repeated calls have no extra effect.

Stops a torrent. Does not block: the torrent enters the "stopping" state and only reaches "stopped" up to ~5s later, once the stop event reaches the trackers. The paused state is persisted and survives a daemon restart.
Restarts a paused torrent and re-arms its completion listener.

bytes_total.description: BytesTotal is 0 until the torrent's metadata arrives.

completed.description:
Completed is piece-derived (TorrentInfo.Completed), not Status-derived — it stays true
for a torrent paused after finishing, which Status alone cannot tell apart from a
paused, unfinished one. Used to key the list sort instead of Status.

episode_number.description: EpisodeNumber is null for batch torrents (they map to several episodes).

eta_seconds.description: EtaSeconds is null when unknown or infinite.

progress.description:
Progress is 0..1: BytesCompleted/BytesTotal normally, falling back to the piece ratio
(PiecesHave/PiecesTotal) when BytesCompleted reads 0 with a paused torrent — see
buildTorrentResponse. 0 while BytesTotal and PiecesTotal are both unknown.

criteria_order.description:
CriteriaOrder é a ordem em que os critérios de sort são aplicados.
Valores válidos: uncensored, source, resolution, codec, fansub, audio, health, size.

ignore_list.description: IgnoreList: substrings (case-insensitive) que descartam o release de vez.
